page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2gne.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. This instance features 8 virtual CPUs across 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, and 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. A key hardware characteristic is the inclusion of 959 GB of bundled local SSD storage, alongside a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. The underlying virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

In terms of benchmark performance, the instance exhibits mixed capabilities. CPU-bound workloads, such as stress-ng single-core and multi-core tests, fall into the bottom 25% tier, as do Geekbench single-core and multi-core scores. However, the processor maintains average performance in Passmark CPU and extended instruction tests. Memory performance is similarly bifurcated; while read-only memory bandwidth benchmarks register in the bottom 25%, large-block write bandwidth achieves average tier performance.

For specific application workloads, the server demonstrates average efficiency in Redis SET operations, processing 6.1 million operations per second, and average prompt processing speeds for small 135M parameter language models. Conversely, heavier tasks such as medium 7B model inference and single-threaded compression show poor performance, placing in the bottom 10%. The combination of dedicated compute resources and substantial bundled SSD storage makes this instance qualitatively cost-effective for localized database operations, caching layers, and general-purpose workloads that require fast local storage but do not demand high-frequency CPU performance.
